No new payment settled. Draft annual invoice $14,400 remains eligible for July 1 batch; no gate executed at cutoff. Sandbox $9,600 preview is not live billing.
Seven-day no-charge continuity gate and conditional paid offers have scoped authority; no perpetual price lock, expansion or settlement approved.

Miri reserves material commercial changes; Noor has genuine prior limited ordinary-renewal delegation and a later old-price annual request. Its current application is disputed, not erased by an admin role label.
